WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    cs.game_id,
    g.title,
    cs.concurrent_players,
    cs.captured_at,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY cs.game_id
      ORDER BY cs.concurrent_players DESC, cs.captured_at ASC

  FROM concurrent_snapshot cs
  JOIN game g USING (game_id)
)
SELECT
  game_id,
  title,
  concurrent_players AS max_concurrent_players,
  captured_at
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY max_concurrent_players DESC
LIMIT 10;
